description: This file defines an abstract class 'InputConnectionsProvider' within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. The class provides interface methods to access various input device connection descriptors (e.g., keyboard, mouse, touchscreen) for integration with virtual machine environments.

classes.name: InputConnectionsProvider
classes.description: An abstract class that specifies interfaces for obtaining input device connection descriptors such as keyboard, mouse, touchscreen, etc.

methods.name: RotaryDeviceConnection
methods.description: Returns a file descriptor for the rotary device connection.

methods.name: MouseConnection
methods.description: Returns a file descriptor for the mouse connection.

methods.name: KeyboardConnection
methods.description: Returns a file descriptor for the keyboard connection.

methods.name: SwitchesConnection
methods.description: Returns a file descriptor for the switches connection.

methods.name: TouchscreenConnections
methods.description: Returns a vector of file descriptors for touchscreen connections.

methods.name: TouchpadConnections
methods.description: Returns a vector of file descriptors for touchpad connections.
